subject: general
question: An ant walks 3 cm South, then 4 cm East. What is the straight-line distance from its starting point to its final position?
solution:
Given:

An ant walks 3 cm South, then 4 cm East.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c1d3b1a56c0486127140e25e94da64990a28dfd26c73098f1cf40335af980eb.png] :

Distance = √(3² + 4²)

= √(9 + 16)

= √25 = 5 cm

Thus, 5 cm is the straight-line distance from its starting point to its final position.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
